meta.note: MAUI colours are #AARRGGBB; translucent values here are rewritten to CSS #rrggbbaa. Token names are the XAML x:Key names.

tokens.name: Brand
tokens.usage: The one action colour: PmPrimaryButton fill, Switch OnColor, ActivityIndicator, RefreshView spinner, selected TabBar icon and title, next-maneuver distance text. 7.29:1 on SurfaceBase, 5.84:1 on SurfaceOverlay.

tokens.name: BrandSoft
tokens.usage: PmSecondaryButton fill. Pair with TextPrimary (7.46:1).

tokens.name: BrandOn
tokens.usage: Text on a Brand fill (PmPrimaryButton label), 7.29:1.

tokens.name: SurfaceBase
tokens.usage: Page and Shell background, WebView backdrop, splash colour. The ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: SurfaceElevated
tokens.usage: Shell TabBar background; end stop of the hero gradient.

tokens.name: SurfaceOverlay
tokens.usage: PmCardBorder fill, PmIconButton fill, header ImageButton fill on Dashboard and Settings.

tokens.name: SurfaceInset
tokens.usage: Things inside a card: PmCardInnerBorder, PmFieldBorder (text inputs), PmLaneChip.

tokens.name: SurfaceGlass
tokens.usage: Defined glass tint; the map overlays actually use MapGlass (translucent). Keep for opaque glass fallbacks.

tokens.name: SurfaceScrim
tokens.usage: Full-screen loading overlay over the map (XAML #D9031712, 85% SurfaceBase).

tokens.name: MapGlass
tokens.usage: Colors.xaml key MapGlass (#E6082720): PmMapGlassCard, PmMapFloatingButton and PmMapMiniButton fills over the live map. 90% SurfaceElevated.

tokens.name: MapSheet
tokens.usage: Colors.xaml key MapSheet (#F2061F19): PmBottomPanel fill, the route-planning bottom sheet. 95% MidnightBlue.

tokens.name: HeroStart
tokens.usage: Colors.xaml key HeroStart: start stop (top-left) of the PmHeroBorder LinearGradientBrush 0,0→1,1; ends on SurfaceElevated.

tokens.name: StrokeStrong
tokens.usage: 1px stroke on hero, map glass, bottom sheet, floating buttons and lane chips. Decorative edge (1.70:1 on SurfaceOverlay); input fields use StrokeField.

tokens.name: StrokeSubtle
tokens.usage: 1px stroke on PmCardBorder and PmCardInnerBorder; PmDivider line between list rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: StrokeField
tokens.usage: PmFieldBorder stroke around text inputs. 3.35:1 on SurfaceOverlay, 3.93:1 on MapSheet, 3.11:1 on SurfaceInset: meets the 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: TextPrimary
tokens.usage: Titles, body, values, route data on SurfaceBase (17.56:1), SurfaceOverlay (14.06:1), SurfaceInset (13.05:1), MapGlass and the hero (9.63:1).

tokens.name: TextSecondary
tokens.usage: PmMutedLabel and PmHeroCaptionLabel: status lines, row subtitles, empty states, hero captions. 7.94:1 on SurfaceOverlay, 5.44:1 on the hero.

tokens.name: TextTertiary
tokens.usage: PmCaptionLabel (uppercase 11px), placeholders, unselected TabBar items. 4.85:1 on SurfaceOverlay, 4.51:1 on SurfaceInset. Not for the hero gradient (3.33:1): captions there use PmHeroCaptionLabel in TextSecondary.

tokens.name: TextAccent
tokens.usage: PmAccentLabel (road names, route progress %) and PmGhostButton text. 10.01:1 on SurfaceOverlay.

tokens.name: StatusSuccess
tokens.usage: PmChip / PmMapBadgeLabel text and PmTonalButton text, on StatusSuccessBg. 6.25:1 composited on SurfaceOverlay.

tokens.name: StatusSuccessBg
tokens.usage: Default chip, map badge and tonal-button fill (XAML #1F10B981, 12% Brand).

tokens.name: StatusWarning
tokens.usage: PmChipWarning text; also the login error chip ground. 6.90:1 on its Bg over SurfaceOverlay.

tokens.name: StatusWarningBg
tokens.usage: PmChipWarning fill (XAML #1FFBBF24).

tokens.name: StatusDanger
tokens.usage: PmErrorLabel and inline route errors. 5.50:1 on SurfaceOverlay, 4.73:1 inside the warning chip.

tokens.name: StatusDangerBg
tokens.usage: Danger tint (XAML #1FFB7185); defined, not yet used by a style.

tokens.name: StatusInfo
tokens.usage: Info accent for icons and marks; chip text uses StatusInfoStrong (StatusInfo is 3.84:1 inside the hero, too low for 11px text).

tokens.name: StatusInfoBg
tokens.usage: PmChipInfo fill (XAML #1F38BDF8).

tokens.name: StatusInfoStrong
tokens.usage: PmChipInfoLabel text (routing engine chip). 4.93:1 on its tint inside the hero, 7.01:1 on SurfaceOverlay. Replaces StatusInfo for chip text.

tokens.name: Primary
tokens.usage: Legacy template key (same as SurfaceBase): default Button fill, CheckBox, ProgressBar. Prefer v2 keys in new XAML.

tokens.name: PrimaryDark
tokens.usage: Legacy: default Button fill in dark AppTheme.

tokens.name: PrimaryDarkText
tokens.usage: Legacy: default Button text.

tokens.name: Secondary
tokens.usage: Legacy teal; second stop of the recenter/voice icon gradient.

tokens.name: SecondaryDarkText
tokens.usage: Legacy deep teal (Android colorSecondaryDark).

tokens.name: Tertiary
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of Brand.

tokens.name: AccentInfo
tokens.usage: Legacy info accent; v2 uses StatusInfo.

tokens.name: AccentWarning
tokens.usage: Legacy, equals StatusWarning.

tokens.name: AccentDanger
tokens.usage: Legacy, equals StatusDanger.

tokens.name: White
tokens.usage: Default Label/Entry text in the template styles, Switch thumb, icon ink (#FFFFFF in the SVGs).

tokens.name: Black
tokens.usage: Legacy darkest ground.

tokens.name: Magenta
tokens.usage: Legacy template key (TabbedPage light bar text); not part of the driving UI.

tokens.name: MidnightBlue
tokens.usage: Legacy Headline/SubHeadline text in light AppTheme; base of MapSheet; Android colorSurface.

tokens.name: OffBlack
tokens.usage: Legacy NavigationPage bar background.

tokens.name: Gray100
tokens.usage: Legacy grey ramp: selected IndicatorView dot.

tokens.name: Gray200
tokens.usage: Legacy: BoxView default, disabled Button text, Picker title.

tokens.name: Gray300
tokens.usage: Legacy: disabled control text (light AppTheme).

tokens.name: Gray400
tokens.usage: Legacy: Switch Off thumb (light).

tokens.name: Gray500
tokens.usage: Legacy: default Border stroke, placeholders, Switch Off thumb. 2.71:1 on SurfaceBase, too low for placeholder text; v2 PmEntry uses TextTertiary.

tokens.name: Gray600
tokens.usage: Legacy: disabled fills and text (dark). Note: equals SurfaceElevated, not a grey.

tokens.name: Gray900
tokens.usage: Legacy: picker text in light AppTheme.

tokens.name: Gray950
tokens.usage: Legacy: equals SurfaceBase.

styles.name: PmPageTitleLabel
styles.usage: One per screen, top-left. FontFamily OpenSansSemibold, HeadingLevel Level1, tail-truncates.

styles.name: PmValueLabel
styles.usage: KPI numbers on Dashboard tiles (Vozila, Nalozi, Ture).

styles.name: ManeuverDistance
styles.usage: Inline in NavigationPage: next-maneuver distance, coloured Brand.

styles.name: PmSectionTitleLabel
styles.usage: Section headings above cards, card titles, the maneuver instruction.

styles.name: PmEntry
styles.usage: Text typed into fields; placeholder in TextTertiary.

styles.name: PmPrimaryButtonText
styles.usage: PmPrimaryButton label. Secondary and ghost buttons use the MAUI default 14px semibold.

styles.name: PmBodyLabel
styles.usage: Body copy and row titles; row titles set FontFamily OpenSansSemibold on top. PmRouteDataLabel is the same 14px, tail-truncated.

styles.name: PmMutedLabel
styles.sample: Manji paneli, više prostora za mapu.
styles.usage: Secondary lines in TextSecondary. PmAccentLabel and PmErrorLabel share this 13px size.

styles.name: PmCaptionLabel
styles.usage: Uppercase (TextTransform) captions above values and fields, in TextTertiary. CharacterSpacing 1. Also PmRouteDataCaption.

styles.name: PmChipLabel
styles.usage: Status chip and map badge text, in the chip's status colour.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's title and its subtitle; between a KPI value and its caption.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page title to status line.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Caption label to its field; maneuver card row gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Field to its side button; chip-to-chip margin in a FlexLayout.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section title to its card; map control column; bottom-sheet stack.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a list row; KPI grid column gap; inner-card padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Map glass card padding; hero stack spacing; field horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card and bottom-sheet padding; map overlay side inset.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page side padding (Dashboard, Settings); hero padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Gap between Dashboard sections (20 on Settings).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page top padding; Login side padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding above the TabBar.

tokens.name: radius-button-default
tokens.usage: Template Button style only; v2 buttons are rounder.

tokens.name: radius-lane
tokens.usage: PmLaneChip.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: PmChip family, PmGhostButton, PmTonalButton.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: PmPrimaryButton, PmSecondaryButton, PmFieldBorder, PmCardInnerBorder.

tokens.name: radius-route-bar
tokens.usage: The ETA / route / speed glass bar on NavigationPage.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: PmCardBorder and PmMapGlassCard.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Route-planning bottom sheet (overrides PmBottomPanel's 24).

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: PmHeroBorder and PmBottomPanel.

tokens.name: radius-pill-44
tokens.usage: Half of a 44px control: PmIconButton and PmMapMiniButton read as pills/discs.

tokens.name: radius-pill-52
tokens.usage: PmMapFloatingButton: a 52px disc.

size.note: Control heights from Styles.xaml (HeightRequest / MinimumHeightRequest). 44 is the floor for every tappable thing.

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: MinimumHeight/Width on every template control; PmIconButton, PmGhostButton, PmMapMiniButton height.

tokens.name: size-button-tonal
tokens.usage: PmTonalButton: the only control below 44, used inside list rows where the row itself is taller.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: PmEntry height; PmSecondaryButton height.

tokens.name: size-button-primary
tokens.usage: PmPrimaryButton height; PmMapFloatingButton width and height.

tokens.name: size-stroke
tokens.usage: StrokeThickness on every bordered surface; PmDivider height.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: MaximumWidthRequest of Dashboard and Settings content (Login: 480).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: ImageButton Disabled state.

tokens.name: opacity-status-bg
tokens.usage: Alpha 0x1F of every Status*Bg tint.

tokens.name: opacity-map-glass
tokens.usage: Alpha 0xE6 of MapGlass over the live map.
